test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The population increases by 13% annually. If the current population is 43,000, what will it be after 3 years? (in approx.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive increment of 13% for 3 years uses the multiplier (1.13)³.

Multiplying factor for 13% = 1 + 0.13 = 1.13

Approximate factor for 3 years ≈ 1.13 × 1.13 × 1.13 = 1.442897

Population ≈ 43,000 × 1.4429 ≈ 62,044.7

The closest value in the options is 62,047.

**∴ The correct answer is 62,047.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Current Population (P) = 43,000

Annual growth rate (R) = 13%

Time (n) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Final Population (A) = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8163c700b917ab06f028c1dc581843082faf8f0028753f0d2e40e518e1829c4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Population after 1st year = 43,000 + (13% of 43,000)

⇒ Population after 1st year = 43,000 + 5,590 = 48,590

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 48,590 + (13% of 48,590)

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 48,590 + 6,316.7 = 54,906.7

⇒ Population after 3rd year = 54,906.7 + (13% of 54,906.7)

⇒ Population after 3rd year = 54,906.7 + 7,137.87 = 62,044.57

⇒ Rounded to nearest option ≈ 62,047

**∴ The correct answer is 62,047.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the net change is (a + b + ab/100)%.

Population Growth Formula

If population decreases, use the formula A = P × (1 − R/100)ⁿ.

Rule of 72

To estimate the time required to double the population, divide 72 by the annual growth rate (72 ÷ R).
